title: Was, were, and once upon a time
summary: Say what someone or something was, and wasn't, with `-dY` on nouns and adjectives (*talypdym*, *öýde däldi*, *bardy*, *Ýadawmydyň?*), pass on what you have found out or heard with *eken* (*Ol mugallym eken*), and take a first look at `-(Y)pdYr` (*Ol gelipdir*), the forms in which folk tales are told.
canDo: Say where you were and what you were like as a child
Talk about the weather and what there was in the past
Pass on something you have just found out or heard
Follow the opening of a Turkmen folk tale
